# SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp – third-party licenses

Applies to `SkiaSharp`, `HarfBuzzSharp` and their `*.NativeAssets.*` packages (MIT). Both packages carry the same `LICENSE.txt`; the packages of the native libraries also contain a `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt` with the licenses of the libraries linked into them (Skia, HarfBuzz, FreeType, libpng, zlib, ANGLE and others), the same in all platform packages.

| `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt` | `skiasharp.nativeassets.linux/3.119.4/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt` (identical to `harfbuzzsharp.nativeassets.linux/8.3.1.3/…`) | `21504c46c4c58aa64c1055bd2dcbc5f9a136b4b8c412ed3cc6740e22c5b127f5` |
